verdict.rationale: Pulumi's Automation API is documented as a programmatic interface for running Pulumi programs without the CLI. It lets the engine be used as an SDK to create, update, configure, and destroy infrastructure from application code. A hands-on community user confirms using it to code infra migrations instead of bash wrappers. missing for 10: in-pack detail on which language SDKs Automation API supports and on preview/refresh operation coverage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive deployments programmatically from my own application code rather than only through the CLI

citations.quote: The Pulumi Automation API is a programmatic interface for running Pulumi programs without the Pulumi CLI.
Automation API lets you use the Pulumi engine as an SDK, enabling you to create software that can create, update, configure, and destroy infrastructure dynamically.
Automation API exposes the full power of infrastructure as code through a programmatic interface, instead of through CLI commands.
Automation API lets you code infra migrations like SQL migrations instead of bash wrappers.
